shortDescription: Information module for Network Device Config

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: createdBy
options.description: CreatedBy query parameter. Comma separated values for createdBy - SCHEDULED, USER, CONFIG_CHANGE_EVENT, SCHEDULED_FIRST_TIME, DR_CALL_BACK, PRE_DEPLOY.

options.name: createdTime
options.description: CreatedTime query parameter. Supported with logical filters GT,GTE,LT,LTE & BT time in milliseconds (epoc format).

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId query parameter. Comma separated device id for example cf35b0a1-407f-412f-b2f4-f0c3156695f9,aaa38191-0c22-4158-befd-779a09d7cec1. If device id is not provided it will fetch for all devices.

options.name: fileType
options.description: FileType query parameter. Config File Type can be RUNNINGCONFIG or STARTUPCONFIG.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. By default, it is set to 500 if not specified, with a maximum limit of 500.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
